acquisition method: The Q Exactive was run in DDA-MS2 top10 method with full MS spectra collected
alkylation reagent: Chloroacetamide was then added at 1 in 100 dilution
alkylation concentration: Chloroacetamide was then added at 1 in 100 dilution
cleavage agent: Cell lysates were quantified and mixed in a 1:1:1 ratio for each SILAC experiment and digested with Lys-C and trypsin.
enrichment method: seven SCX fractions were phospho-peptide enriched using titanium dioxide beads
fractionation method: Peptides were then separated into fractions using strong cation exchange chromatography (SCX)
instrument: Samples were analysed by LC-MS/MS on a Q-Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer
ionization type: loaded onto a 50 cm C18 EasySpray column
labeling: stable isotope labelling by amino acids in cell culture (SILAC)
Modulation of cell signaling following inhibitor treatment was quantified using global phosphoproteomics and stable isotope labelling by amino acids in cell culture (SILAC)
reduction reagent: 1 mM Dithiothritol was then added to this mixture
reduction concentration: 1 mM Dithiothritol was then added to this mixture
